hero.title: A refined stay in the heart of Bitola

hotel.introTitle: Comfort, privacy and an easy arrival
hotel.introText: Three floors and nine accommodation units create a calm, intimate base for discovering Bitola. Every unit has a private bathroom, while self check-in makes arrival simple and flexible.
hotel.courtyard: A quiet grass-and-tree courtyard sits behind the property.
hotel.selfCheck: Self check-in with a door PIN and written instructions.
hotel.cleaning: Cleaning, towels and bedding are provided approximately every 2 days.

attractions.description: Explore the streets, landmarks, museums and natural surroundings of Bitola.

sirok.name: Širok Sokak
sirok.description: Bitola's best-known pedestrian street and a natural starting point for exploring the city.

clock.name: Clock Tower / Saat Kula
clock.description: One of Bitola's defining landmarks and a central point for a walk through the city.

heraclea.name: Heraclea Lyncestis
heraclea.description: An important archaeological site associated with ancient Bitola.

magnolia.name: Magnolia Square
magnolia.description: A central urban square surrounded by characteristic city architecture and activity.

bazaar.description: A historic commercial quarter with traditional urban character.

isak.name: Isak Mosque
isak.description: A notable religious and architectural landmark in Bitola.

yeni.name: Yeni Mosque
yeni.description: Another of Bitola's historic Ottoman-era architectural landmarks.

philip.name: Philip II Statue
philip.description: A prominent city landmark in Bitola.

museum.name: Bitola Museum
museum.description: A museum destination for visitors interested in the city's history and culture.

pelister.name: Pelister National Park
pelister.description: A natural destination near Bitola for mountain landscapes and outdoor exploration.

location.title: A convenient Bitola base
location.description: PAPARAZZI Luxury Apartments is in Bitola, North Macedonia. The Clock Tower is approximately 600 m away and Širok Sokak approximately 1 km away.
location.parking: Street parking is available in front of the property.
